_comment: Camera -> graph entity it is watching, per entity type. Names must match the seeded graph's id/name/aliases (Shresth/rescuegrid/neo4j/schema/seed_static.cypher) or Kenil's fusion agent creates a stray node. A frame's `entities` form field overrides this per request. report_open: a road camera reports `open` from tier 1 when it sees normal traffic.
